title: Clean Configurable 3D Grid
description: Fix overlapping 3D grids so the viewport shows one clean regular grid, and expose the grid configuration in window options.
summary: Made the single 3D grid dynamically cover the exact camera-frustum intersection with its Z plane for perspective and orthographic cameras. Grid geometry now grows in stable power-of-two bands, remains world-aligned, keeps exact configurable spacing, and uses unbounded regular LOD spacing instead of disappearing past LOD 1000. Added camera-distance, orthographic-zoom, frustum-coverage, spacing, and unbounded-LOD tests.
